description: Rep. Rafferty, a veteran of the U.S. Marine Corps, has served Alabama House District 54 since 2018. He is a passionate legislator and leader focused on healthcare, social justice, economic growth, LGBTQ+ rights, expanding opportunities, and strongly committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion.
